flowchart.guidePrompt: Select a node to see how it participates in program flow.

explanations.Exit: Function exit: control returns to the caller.
explanations.Process: Sequential statement {code}; execution then moves to the next node.
explanations.Call: Call {code}; control returns here when the function completes.
explanations.Decision: Decision {code}: follow {true} when true and {false} when false.
explanations.LoopDecision: Loop condition {code}: repeat the body or continue after the loop.
explanations.Return: Return {code}: finish the function and return its value.
explanations.Continue: Skip the rest of the current iteration and continue with the nearest loop.
explanations.Partial: Partial node generated from incomplete code.
explanations.Group: Collapsed group of sequential statements; double-click to expand it.
